# Nxeon Workspace — System Spec (shared contract for all agents)

Public URL: https://workspace.trynxeon.com  (VPS 139.99.125.21, Ubuntu 24.04, 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM)
Repo root: /opt/nxeon-workspace  (owned by user `claude`; use `sudo docker ...` — group membership not active in current shells)

## 1. Goal
A self-hosted, multi-user, multi-project Claude Code workspace. Every browser talks ONLY to
Caddy on this VPS. Browser → Caddy (TLS) → `app` container → `claudebox` container → Anthropic.
No browser ever contacts Anthropic or any third party (no CDNs, no Google fonts at runtime,
no Web Speech API — voice is transcribed on-box). All prompts/files/events are stored on the VPS.

Visual identity: warm pink + black cyberpunk "mainframe". Uncluttered, polished, fast.

## 2. Topology (docker compose, file: /opt/nxeon-workspace/docker-compose.yml)

| service    | dir            | listens                          | exposed to host        |
|------------|----------------|----------------------------------|------------------------|
| app        | server/ + web/ | :8080 (HTTP + WS)                | 127.0.0.1:8080 only    |
| claudebox  | claudebox/     | :3000 API, :4100-4199 previews   | not published          |
| whisper    | whisper/       | :9000                            | not published          |

Docker network `nxeon` (internal bridge). Caddy on host: `workspace.trynxeon.com { reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8080 }`
(basic_auth removed once app auth works; keep security headers but X-Frame-Options must allow
SAMEORIGIN for the preview iframe).

Volumes (bind mounts under /opt/nxeon-workspace/data):
- `data/projects`  → app:`/data/projects`, claudebox:`/workspace/projects`  (one dir per project slug)
- `data/uploads`   → app:`/data/uploads`,  claudebox:`/workspace/.private/uploads` (read-only, under a 0700 dir)
- `data/claude-home` → claudebox:`/home/claude/.claude` (legacy shared Claude store; read-only source of the one-time
  session migration, inaccessible to sandboxes)
- `data/sandbox-homes` → claudebox:`/workspace/.sandbox-homes` (per-project HOME: Claude config + sessions for --resume,
  caches, TMPDIR, attachment copies — see §9)
- `data/db`        → app:`/data/db` (SQLite `nxeon.db`)
- `.env` (root, chmod 600): secrets — `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY`, `SESSION_SECRET`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` or
  `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `ADMIN_EMAIL`, `ADMIN_PASSWORD` (bootstrap).
File ownership: app + claudebox server run as uid 1000 (the node image's `node` user, renamed `claude` in claudebox).
Project trees are owned by per-project sandbox uids/gids; uid 1000 keeps access through POSIX ACLs (§9). Never
`chown -R` data/projects or data/sandbox-homes.

## 3. claudebox (fork of github.com/ArmanJR/claudebox, MIT — keep LICENSE + credit)
Keep original `/prompt`, `/health`, `/v1/*` behaviour. ADD (all require `Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY`):

### POST /v2/run  → `text/event-stream` (SSE). Body:
```json
{
  "runId": "uuid (from app)",
  "prompt": "string",
  "projectSlug": "my-app",            // cwd = /workspace/projects/<slug>  (must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$)
  "sessionId": "claude session id | null",   // → --resume
  "model": "opus|sonnet|haiku|<full id>",
  "mode": "auto|edit|plan|ask",
  "thinking": "off|normal|max",       // → env MAX_THINKING_TOKENS 0 / 8000 / 32000
  "attachments": ["/workspace/uploads/<id>/<file>"],  // appended to prompt as "[Attached file: path — use Read tool]"
  "appendSystemPrompt": "string",
  "maxTurns": 50,
  "previewPort": 4123
}
```
Spawns `claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages` with flags.
Mode mapping:
- auto  → `--permission-mode bypassPermissions` (full tools)
- edit  → `--permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools Read Edit Write Glob Grep Bash WebFetch WebSearch TodoWrite`
- plan  → `--permission-mode plan`
- ask   → `--allowedTools Read Glob Grep WebFetch WebSearch` (no writes / no bash)
(Verify flags against the installed CLI `claude --help`; adapt and document in claudebox/PROTOCOL.md.)

SSE stream emits ONLY these NORMALIZED events (`event: <type>\ndata: <json>\n\n`); raw CLI output is
never forwarded as-is:
| type         | data |
|--------------|------|
| `init`       | `{sessionId, model, tools:[], cwd}` |
| `thinking`   | `{delta}` streaming thinking text |
| `text`       | `{delta}` streaming assistant text |
| `block_end`  | `{kind:"thinking"|"text"}` |
| `tool_use`   | `{id, name, input}` (complete input once known) |
| `tool_result`| `{id, isError, content}` (content truncated to 20 KB string) |
| `todo`       | `{todos:[{content,status}]}` (derived from TodoWrite) |
| `usage`      | `{inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens}` incremental per assistant msg |
| `rate_limit` | raw-ish info if CLI emits rate limit events |
| `result`     | `{sessionId, isError, result, durationMs, numTurns, costUsd, usage:{...totals}}` |
| `error`      | `{message}` |
| `done`       | `{exitCode}` always last |

### POST /v2/abort `{runId}` → kills that run's process tree.
### GET  /v2/runs → active runs. GET /health → add `version`, `claudeVersion`, `authMode`.
### Preview process manager
- `POST /v2/preview/start {projectSlug, port, command?}` → runs `command` (default: detect — `npm run dev`
  with `PORT`/`HOST=0.0.0.0`/`BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>/`, or `npx serve -l <port>` for static) detached, logs captured.
- `POST /v2/preview/stop {projectSlug}`, `GET /v2/preview/status?projectSlug=` → `{running, port, pid, logTail}`.
- Claude itself may also start servers on its assigned port via Bash; appendSystemPrompt (built by app) tells it:
  project dir, preview port, base path `/preview/<slug>/`, bind 0.0.0.0.

### Firewall
`FIREWALL_MODE=open` (default for this deployment): allow all public internet egress (npm, pip, git, web),
DROP egress to RFC1918/link-local/metadata (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 169.254/16, 100.64/10) except DNS
resolvers. `FIREWALL_MODE=allowlist` keeps original behaviour. IPv6: allow global unicast only in open mode or drop.

Auth: `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (from `claude setup-token`, long-lived) OR `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Pass through.
Claude Code version: latest `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` at build time (build arg overridable).
Image also includes: git, python3, pip, build-essential, ripgrep, common dev tooling so Claude can "set up applications".

## 4. whisper (on-box speech-to-text)
`POST /transcribe` multipart field `audio` (webm/ogg/wav/mp3 from MediaRecorder) → `{text, language, durationMs}`.
Implementation: whisper.cpp server (or faster-whisper) with model `base.en`/`small` multilingual (pick for CPU speed:
target < 3 s for 10 s of audio on 4 vCPU). ffmpeg conversion inside container. Model files baked in or cached in data/whisper-models.
Internal only; app proxies `POST /api/transcribe`.

## 5. app (server/ — Node 22, TypeScript, Fastify, @fastify/websocket, better-sqlite3, zod, argon2)
Serves built SPA from `web/dist` and all APIs under `/api`. Single multi-stage Dockerfile at repo root `Dockerfile.app`
builds web + server.

### Auth & users
- Email+password (argon2id), httpOnly secure SameSite=Lax session cookie (`nx_sid`), CSRF via SameSite + `X-Requested-With`.
- Roles: `admin`, `member`. Per-project membership with permission level: `owner|editor|viewer`
  (viewer: read chat/files/preview; editor: prompt + edit files + preview control; owner: + manage members/delete).
  Admins see everything.
- Bootstrap admin from env on first start. Admin can create/disable users, reset passwords, set per-user limits
  (daily token budget, allowed models, allowed modes).
- Login rate limiting + lockout; all requests logged with client IP (Caddy `X-Forwarded-For`, trust only 127.0.0.1).
- Admin IP rules: allowlist/blocklist CIDRs (if allowlist non-empty, only those IPs may access; admins can never lock
  themselves out from the IP they set it from — warn).

### Data model (SQLite, WAL)
users, sessions, projects(id, slug, name, description, color, icon, previewPort, previewCommand, links JSON, createdAt,
archived), project_members, conversations(id, projectId, title, claudeSessionId, model, mode, createdBy),
messages(id, conversationId, role user|assistant, content, attachments JSON, runId, createdAt),
runs(id, conversationId, userId, status queued|running|done|error|aborted, model, mode, startedAt, endedAt,
inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheRead, cacheWrite, costUsd, durationMs, ip),
run_events(runId, seq, type, data JSON) — full normalized event log (replay + "thinking" history),
uploads(id, userId, projectId, filename, mime, size, path, createdAt), audit_log(id, userId, ip, action, target, meta, ts),
request_log(ts, ip, userId, method, path, status, ms) (sampled/trimmed to 30 days), ip_rules, settings(key, value).

### REST (JSON; errors `{error:{code,message}}`)
- `POST /api/auth/login|logout`, `GET /api/auth/me`, `POST /api/auth/password`
- `GET/POST /api/projects`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/:id`, `GET/PUT /api/projects/:id/members`
- `GET /api/projects/graph` → `{nodes:[{id,slug,name,color,icon,status:'idle'|'running'|'error',activity:0..1,lastActiveAt}], links:[{source,target,kind}]}`
  links = user-defined relations + shared-member affinity; plus a central "core" node id `core`.
- `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/conversations`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/conversations/:id`,
  `GET /api/conversations/:id/messages` (with runs + events for assistant messages)
- `POST /api/conversations/:id/prompt {text, attachments:[uploadId], model, mode, thinking}` → `{runId, messageId}`
- `POST /api/runs/:id/abort`
- `POST /api/uploads` (multipart, max 50 MB/file, any type; images get thumbnails) → `{id, filename, mime, size, url}`;
  `GET /api/uploads/:id` (auth-checked)
- `POST /api/transcribe` (multipart audio) → `{text}`
- Files (scoped to /data/projects/<slug>, path traversal-safe, ignore node_modules/.git in tree):
  `GET /api/projects/:id/files/tree`, `GET /api/projects/:id/files/content?path=`, `PUT ... {path, content}`,
  `POST /api/projects/:id/files/rename|delete|mkdir`, `GET /api/projects/:id/files/download?path=` (zip for dirs)
- Preview: `POST /api/projects/:id/preview/start|stop`, `GET /api/projects/:id/preview/status`
- `GET /api/usage/me` → today/7d/30d tokens, cost, runs, by model; plus limits
- `GET /api/models` → `[{id:'opus',label:'Opus 5.5'},{id:'sonnet',label:'Sonnet 5.5'},{id:'haiku',label:'Haiku 4.5'}]` (admin-configurable)
- Admin (`/api/admin/*`, admin only): `overview` (KPIs: active users, runs today, tokens today, cost, error rate,
  active runs, req/min), `timeseries?metric=tokens|runs|requests|cost&range=24h|7d|30d&groupBy=user|project|model`,
  `users` CRUD, `users/:id/projects` grants, `prompts?userId&projectId&q&cursor` (full prompt log incl attachments),
  `activity` (audit log), `traffic` (requests by IP/path/status, top IPs, geo not required), `ip-rules` CRUD,
  `runs/active` + abort any, `settings` (models list, default model, global daily token cap, claude auth token update →
  writes .env value & restarts claudebox via docker socket is NOT allowed; instead store in settings and pass token per run
  as env `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` in /v2/run body field `authToken` — claudebox uses body token over env if present).

### Live channel: WebSocket `GET /ws` (cookie auth)
Client → server: `{t:'sub', runId}`, `{t:'unsub', runId}`, `{t:'sub_project', projectId}`, `{t:'ping'}`.
Server → client:
- `{t:'run_event', runId, seq, type, data}` (normalized events above, persisted first, replay from `fromSeq` on sub)
- `{t:'run_status', runId, conversationId, projectId, status}`
- `{t:'file_change', projectId, path, kind:'add'|'change'|'unlink'|'addDir'|'unlinkDir'}` (chokidar, debounced 150 ms)
- `{t:'preview_status', projectId, running, port}`
- `{t:'graph_pulse', projectId, intensity}` (drives the spider-web animation)
- `{t:'suggestions', runId, items:[{label, prompt, kind:'next'|'fix'|'test'|'deploy'|'explain'}]}`
Runs continue server-side if the browser disconnects; reconnect + `sub` replays.

### Actionable suggestions
appendSystemPrompt (built per run) instructs Claude to end every final reply with
`<nx-suggestions>[{"label":"…","prompt":"…","kind":"next"}]</nx-suggestions>` (2–4 items). Server strips that block
from the displayed text, validates JSON, emits `suggestions`, stores on the message.
Also includes project context: name, description, cwd, preview port, preview URL path `/preview/<slug>/`, "bind 0.0.0.0",
"use the assigned port", "you have internet access", "keep a README.md".

### Preview proxy
`/preview/<slug>/*` (HTTP + WebSocket upgrade for HMR) → `http://claudebox:<previewPort>/preview/<slug>/*`
(do NOT strip the prefix; apps are told to use that base path. Also support `?strip=1` project setting to strip prefix
for apps that can't set a base). Auth: session cookie + project viewer permission. Set
`Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'` on the app and previews.

## 6. web/ (React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + zustand + lucide-react + recharts + Monaco)
EVERYTHING bundled locally (Monaco via `loader.config({ monaco })` from the `monaco-editor` package — never the CDN;
fonts self-hosted via @fontsource: "JetBrains Mono" + "Space Grotesk" or "Rajdhani"/"Orbitron" for headings).

Palette (CSS vars): bg `#07050a`, panel `#0f0a12`, panel-2 `#160e1a`, border `#2a1626`, text `#f6e9f0`, muted `#a68a99`,
pink `#ff3e8a`, hot-pink `#ff6fae`, warm `#ff8a5c` (accent 2), violet `#b14bff` (sparingly), success `#3dffb5`,
warn `#ffc857`, danger `#ff4d6d`. Subtle scanlines/grid, glows on focus, no garish overload.

### Screens
1. **Login** — terminal-style mainframe boot animation, minimal.
2. **Nexus (home)** — full-screen animated spider-web network: central core node, project nodes on a force/radial
   layout, silk strands with traveling light pulses (pulse intensity from `graph_pulse`), nodes breathe when a run is
   active, hover → card (name, last activity, status), click → zoom transition into project. Canvas 2D (60 fps,
   devicePixelRatio aware, pan/zoom, drag nodes, reduced-motion support). `⌘K` command palette to jump to any project /
   create project. "+ New project" node.
3. **Project workspace** — 3-zone layout, resizable, collapsible (keep it clean):
   - Left rail: file explorer (live updates via `file_change`), conversations list.
   - Center: chat. Messages stream. Assistant message shows a collapsible "Thinking" lane (live streaming thinking text,
     dimmed), an "Activity" timeline translating tool_use into plain language ("Reading src/App.tsx", "Running `npm i`",
     "Searching web for …", expandable details/results), todo checklist, final markdown (code highlighting via shiki or
     highlight.js bundled), suggestion chips (click → prefill/send). Stop button while running.
   - Prompt box: autosize textarea, attach button, paste images, drag-and-drop files anywhere on workspace (overlay),
     thumbnails + remove, mic button (MediaRecorder → /api/transcribe, waveform indicator, result inserted),
     model switcher, mode switcher (Auto / Edit / Plan / Ask with icons + tooltips), thinking level, `Enter` send,
     `Shift+Enter` newline, slash commands (/clear new conversation, /preview, /model …).
   - Right: tabs **Preview** (iframe of /preview/<slug>/, URL bar, refresh, device widths, start/stop, auto-reload on
     file_change, open in new tab, logs) and **Code** (Monaco, tabs, read-only toggle, save with ⌘S, live reload of open
     file on external change with "changed by Claude" flash, diff highlight of recent edits).
   - Top bar: project name, breadcrumb back to Nexus, usage meter (today tokens / limit), status light.
4. **Admin** (`/admin`, admins only): Overview KPIs + charts (tokens, runs, requests over time; by model/user/project),
   Live (active runs w/ abort, live request feed), Prompts (searchable log, view full conversation + attachments),
   Users (CRUD, roles, disable, limits, project grants with permission level), Projects (all, members), Traffic
   (top IPs, status codes, paths), Security (IP rules, login failures, audit log), Settings (models, defaults, Claude
   auth token, global caps).
5. **Usage** popover / page for the user.

Responsive down to tablet; mobile shows chat-first with tabs.

## 7. Conventions
- TypeScript strict everywhere. No external network calls at runtime from browser.
- Shared types: `server/src/shared/protocol.ts` is the source of truth for WS + run events; web imports a copy
  (`web/src/shared/protocol.ts`, kept identical).
- Ports/hosts via env. Logs JSON to stdout.
- Don't commit secrets. `.env.example` documents vars.

## 8. Sub-projects, git branches, checkpoints, topics (v4)
- **Sub-projects**: `projects.parent_id` (max depth 2). A child is a full project (own dir/slug/port/chats).
  Effective role = max(own membership, membership on the parent); admins see all. `POST /api/projects {parentId}`
  (editor on parent), `PATCH /api/projects/:id {parentId|null}` (owner), `DELETE /api/projects/:id` → 409 `has_children`
  unless `?cascade=1`. Slugs may not contain `--`.
- **Git**: every project dir is a git repo (init or adopt on startup/first use; existing repo's current branch = main;
  `.gitignore` gets node_modules, dist, .next, .venv, __pycache__, .DS_Store). All git runs in claudebox
  (`POST /v2/git/<op>`, see claudebox/PROTOCOL.md) because worktree metadata holds absolute paths that must be the
  paths Claude sees (`/workspace/projects/...`); the app image has no git.
- **Branches** = worktrees at `projects/.branches/<slug>/<dir>` (`dir` = name with `/`→`_`, stable across renames),
  table `branches` (status active|merged|discarded, own `preview_port` from 4100-4199). Everything branch-scoped takes
  `?branch=<name>`: files, preview, conversations (`conversations.branch`, NULL = main), runs (`worktree` → cwd).
  Preview: `/preview/<slug>--<dir>/` (BASE_PATH likewise; proxy splits at the last `--`).
  `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/branches`, `PATCH|DELETE /api/projects/:id/branches/:name` (rename | discard),
  `GET .../branches/:name/diff`, `GET .../branches/:name/diff/file?path=`, `POST .../branches/:name/merge {close}` →
  `{ok, sha}` or `{ok:false, conflicts, resolvePrompt}` (main untouched). Closing a branch moves its chats to main.
- **Checkpoints**: pending edits are committed right before a run ("nxeon: edits before run"), and every successful run
  is committed as `nxeon: <first 60 chars of prompt>` (`runs.commit_sha`). `GET /api/projects/:id/history?branch=`,
  `POST /api/projects/:id/checkpoint?branch=`, `POST /api/runs/:id/undo` / `POST /api/projects/:id/history/:sha/revert`
  (`git revert --no-edit`, `runs.undo_sha`).
- **Topics**: `topics(id, project_id, name, color, sort)`, `conversations.topic_id` (ON DELETE SET NULL).
  `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/topics`, `PATCH/DELETE /api/topics/:id`, `PATCH /api/conversations/:id {topicId}`.
- **Graph**: `GET /api/projects/graph?satellites=1` adds `kind: 'branch'|'topic'` nodes (`parentId`); projects carry
  `kind: 'project'|'subproject'` + `parentId`; links `child|branch|topic`. WS: `sub_project {branch}` watches a worktree;
  `file_change|preview_status|run_status|graph_pulse` carry `branch`; `project_changed {what}` signals refetches.

## 9. Per-project sandbox (claudebox `SANDBOX_MODE=strict`, default)
Full model: claudebox/PROTOCOL.md "Sandbox". Summary:
- `projects.sandbox_id` (migration v5, assigned at creation, monotonic via `settings.sandbox_seq`, never reused;
  backfilled in creation order). uid = gid = `20000 + sandbox_id`; branches/worktrees use their project's id,
  sub-projects their own. `server/src/lib/sandbox.ts` builds the spec `{uid, gid, groups, home}`; the Claudebox client
  attaches it to every project-scoped call (runs, previews, git, `/v2/sandbox/setup`), and `ensureGit` sets the sandbox
  up first (ownership + ACLs, home, one-time migration of the project's Claude sessions into its home).
- Claude runs, preview dev servers and git run as that uid via the root helper `nx-sandbox` (setpriv, no caps,
  no_new_privs, umask 007, own HOME/TMPDIR/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/npm prefix). Project dirs are `1000:<gid> 2770` + ACLs
  (uid 1000 = app/claudebox keep full access); roots are traverse-only. No sudo inside runs.
- Attachments are copied into the run's home (`$HOME/uploads/<id>/`); uploads themselves are invisible to sandboxes.
- Preview ports are bound to their project's uid with iptables owner rules (no cross-project access or port squatting).
- Multi-project runs (Nexus Chat): app computes `multiProjectSandbox(30000+n, projects)` (supplementary groups) and

- Emergency: `SANDBOX_MODE=off` in .env/compose + restart claudebox (old shared-uid behaviour).

## Git (`POST /v2/git/<op>`, JSON body, all take `projectSlug`)

In strict mode every `git` process runs **as the project's sandbox uid** (through the helper): repo config,
`.gitattributes` filters, fsmonitor, textconv etc. are controlled by that project's Claude and must never run
with the server's privileges. Bodies may carry `sandbox` (then the project is set up first); otherwise the
identity comes from the project dir's group. The temp index used for diffs lives next to the real index.

Every project dir is a git repo (user `Nxeon <nxeon@workspace.local>`, hooks disabled for these calls);
a branch is a worktree at `.branches/<slug>/<worktree>`. Operations are serialized per repository.
Worktree names match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$`; new branch names `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*(/[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)*$`.

| op | body | result |
|---|---|---|
| `ensure` | — | init (`-b main`) + `.gitignore` (node_modules, dist, .next, .venv, __pycache__, .DS_Store) + initial snapshot; an existing repo is adopted and its current branch is main → `{mainBranch, head, initialized, adopted}` |
| `branch/create` | `{branch, worktree, base}` | `git worktree add [-b branch] <path> base` (an existing ref is checked out as-is) |
| `branch/remove` | `{branch, worktree, deleteRef?}` | `worktree remove --force` + `branch -D` |
| `branch/rename` | `{from, to}` | `git branch -m` (worktree dir unchanged) |
| `checkpoint` | `{worktree?, message, expectBranch?}` | `add -A` + commit if anything changed → `{sha|null, files}`; `{skipped:"head_moved"|"detached_head"|"unmerged"}` when HEAD isn't on `expectBranch` |
| `diff` | `{worktree?, base}` | working tree (incl. untracked, via a temp index) vs `merge-base(HEAD, base)` → `{files:[{path,status,additions,deletions,binary}], additions, deletions, mergeBase, head}` |
| `file-diff` | `{worktree?, base, path}` | `{path, status, original, modified, patch, binary}` |
| `status` | `{branches:[{worktree, base}]}` | `{mainBranch, mainDirty, branches:[{worktree, ahead, behind, filesChanged, dirty}]}` |
| `history` | `{worktree?, limit?}` | `{commits:[{sha, parents, time, author, message, filesChanged, insertions, deletions}], dirty, branch}` |
| `merge` | `{branch, worktree?, into}` | checkpoints both sides, dry-runs `merge-tree --write-tree`, then `merge --no-ff` in the main dir → `{ok:true, sha}` or `{ok:false, conflicts:[...]}` (main is never left conflicted); 409 `main_head_moved` |
| `revert` | `{worktree?, sha, expectBranch?}` | checkpoints pending edits, `git revert --no-edit sha` → `{ok, sha}` / `{ok:false, conflicts}` (aborted) |

Errors: `{error}` with 400 (validation) / 404 (missing worktree/ref) / 409 / 500.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` | — | Bearer token for `/v2/*` (and `/v1/*` if set). Required. |
| `CLAUDEBOX_ALLOW_NO_AUTH` | `0` | `1` = allow `/v2/*` without a key (dev only). |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | — | Default Claude auth (optional; per-run `authToken` overrides). |
| `PORT` | `3000` | API port. |
| `MAX_CONCURRENT` | `4` | Max simultaneous runs (and legacy `/prompt` requests). |
| `PROJECTS_DIR` | `/workspace/projects` | Project root (cwd = `<dir>/<slug>`). |
| `UPLOADS_DIR` | `/workspace/.private/uploads` | Allowed attachment root (mount read-only, below the 0700 dir `/workspace/.private`). |
| `PREVIEW_PORT_MIN` / `PREVIEW_PORT_MAX` | `4100` / `4199` | Allowed preview ports. |
| `PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOST` | `claudebox` | Passed to vite via `__VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. |
| `RUN_RETENTION_MS` | `1800000` | How long finished runs stay replayable. |
| `AUTO_PERMISSION_MODE` | `bypassPermissions` | Permission mode used for `mode=auto` (`auto` to use the classifier mode). |
| `THINKING_DISPLAY` | `summarized` | Passed as `--thinking-display` unless thinking=off (newer CLIs stream empty thinking otherwise). Empty string disables. `thinking=max` also adds `--effort high`. |
| `FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT` | `1` | `0` = don't pass `--forward-subagent-text`. |
| `CLAUDE_BIN` | `claude` | CLI binary (tests point this at `test/mock-claude.js`). |
| `FIREWALL_MODE` | `open` | `open` \| `allowlist` \| `off`. |
| `FIREWALL_ALLOW_CIDRS` | — | Comma-separated private CIDRs to exempt in `open` mode. |
| `SANDBOX_MODE` | `strict` | `strict`: per-project uids (see "Sandbox"); uid 1000 may only `sudo nx-sandbox`. `off`: emergency fallback to the old shared-uid mode (sessions still live in the per-project homes when they exist). |
| `CLAUDE_SUDO` | `1` | `SANDBOX_MODE=off` only: `0` removes the claude user's sudo rights at startup. |
| `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` | `/home/claude/.claude` | Claude Code state (sessions for `--resume`, `.claude.json`, credentials). Mount a volume here. |
| `OPENAI_COMPAT` | `0` | Original OpenAI-compatible endpoints. |

## Firewall (entrypoint, needs `--cap-add NET_ADMIN`)

`open` mode (IPv4 `OUTPUT`): accept `lo`; accept `ESTABLISHED,RELATED` (replies to inbound
connections from the app on :3000 / :4100-4199 and to our own egress); accept DNS to the
`/etc/resolv.conf` nameservers and the default gateway; **reject** new connections to
`0/8 10/8 100.64/10 127/8 169.254/16 172.16/12 192.0.0/24 192.168/16 198.18/15 224/4 240/4`
(covers the docker network's own subnet and cloud metadata); accept everything else.
REJECT (icmp-admin-prohibited) is used rather than DROP so blocked tools fail fast instead of hanging.
IPv6: accept `lo`, established, ICMPv6; reject `fe80::/10 fc00::/7 ::ffff:0:0/96 ::1 ff00::/8`; accept `2000::/3`; reject rest.

The entrypoint runs as root, then drops to `claude` (uid 1000) via `setpriv` with `NET_RAW` and
`SYS_ADMIN` removed from the bounding set (`SANDBOX_MODE=off`: also `NET_ADMIN`, so even `sudo` cannot modify
the firewall). In strict mode `NET_ADMIN` stays in the bounding set only so that root-via-`nx-sandbox
net-claim` can manage the per-port rules below; sandboxed processes run with an empty bounding set.
`allowlist` mode is the original claudebox behaviour (`/etc/allowed-domains.txt`).

## Sandbox (SANDBOX_MODE=strict, default)

Goal: a run or preview of project P can't read, list, modify or delete other projects' files, other projects'
Claude sessions or other users' uploads, can't signal or inspect other projects' processes, and can't escalate.

**Identities.** Every project has `projects.sandbox_id` (app DB, assigned at creation, never reused);
its uid **and** gid are `20000 + sandbox_id` (20001-29999). Branch worktrees and sub-projects use their own
project's id. 30000-39999 is reserved for per-user multi-project ("Nexus") identities. passwd/group entries
(`nx<uid>`) are created lazily by the helper (tools such as `os.userInfo()` need them).

**Files.** `/workspace/projects`, `.branches` and `/workspace/.sandbox-homes` are `1000:1000 0711` (traverse only —
no sandbox can list them). A project dir, its `.branches/<slug>` dir and its home are `1000:<gid>` mode `2770` with
POSIX ACLs `u:1000:rwx` + default ACLs `u::rwx,u:1000:rwx,g::rwx,m::rwx,o::---`: the sandbox reaches its files via
the group, uid 1000 (the app container and the claudebox server) via the ACL, new files inherit both, nobody else
gets in. The top dirs are owned by uid 1000 so a sandbox can't `chmod` them open. Contents are owned by the
project uid. `/workspace/.trash`, `/home/claude` (legacy shared Claude store), `/workspace/.private` (uploads) and
`/run/nx-sandbox` are 0700 (uid 1000).

**Home.** `HOME=/workspace/.sandbox-homes/<uid>` (volume `data/sandbox-homes`): `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.claude`
(sessions for `--resume`, `.claude.json`), `TMPDIR=$HOME/tmp`, `NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX=$HOME/.npm-global`, npm/pip/
playwright caches, `$HOME/uploads` (attachment copies), `$HOME/.nxeon/runs/<runId>` (per-run prompt files).

**Helper.** `/usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox` (root-owned bash; the only sudo rule: `claude ALL=(root) NOPASSWD:
/usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox`; sandbox uids have no sudo at all). Fixed paths, strict argument validation:

| op | does |
|---|---|
| `exec --uid U --gid G [--groups G,…] --cwd D [--env-file F] [--setenv K=V]… -- cmd…` | `setpriv --reuid U --regid G --groups … --inh-caps=-all --ambient-caps=-all --bounding-set=-all --no-new-privs`, then `env -i -C D <env> cmd` (the chdir happens *after* the uid switch), umask 007. `gid == uid`; groups in range; D must be a clean path under `/workspace/projects/<slug>`, `.branches/<slug>/…` or `/workspace/.nexus/…` whose top dir's group is one of the groups. The env comes from a 0600 file in `/run/nx-sandbox` (owned by uid 1000; deleted after reading) — secrets never appear in argv. HOME/PATH/TMPDIR/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX are set by the helper. |
| `kill --uid U --pgid P --signal S` | `kill -S -P` executed **as U** (only U's members of the group can be hit). |
| `kill-port --uid U --port N [--protect pg,…]` | as U: find U's LISTEN sockets on N (`/proc/net/tcp*` + own `/proc/*/fd`), kill their process groups (protected = running Claude runs: only the listener pid). |
| `setup --uid U --slug S [--force]` | top-dir ownership/ACLs, home; first time (marker `$HOME/.nxeon-setup`) or `--force`: normalize the whole tree (owner U, group G, g+rw, setgid dirs, o-rwx, ACLs) and **migrate Claude sessions** (see below). Refuses a dir that already belongs to another sandbox. |
| `fixperms --uid U --slug S` | after every run: re-own/re-chmod only entries that drifted (e.g. a tool's explicit `chmod 600`). |
| `net-claim --port N --uids U[,…]` | iptables: only these uids may serve/connect to local preview port N. |
| `home --uid U --gid U` | create a (Nexus) identity's home. |

claudebox calls `setup` the first time it sees a project (from `sandbox` in a request; the app calls
`/v2/sandbox/setup` before `git ensure`, i.e. for every project at app start), then runs Claude, preview dev
servers and git through `exec`. The built-in static preview server runs inside the claudebox process (uid 1000)
and only serves the realpath-checked project dir. Requests in strict mode without a resolvable sandbox → 409;
helper missing → 503.

**Session migration.** Claude keys sessions by cwd (`$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects/<cwd with every non
[A-Za-z0-9] char → '-'>/`). On first setup the dirs of the project's cwd and of every existing worktree under
`.branches/<slug>/` are copied (`cp -a -u`) from the legacy store `/home/claude/.claude/projects` into
`$HOME/.claude/projects`, plus `.claude.json` (if missing). Existing conversations keep `--resume`-ing; the legacy
store is left untouched (backup) and is unreadable for sandboxes.

**Processes / network.** Other uids' `/proc/<pid>/environ`, `cwd`, `fd` are not readable (ptrace rules) and
signals across uids fail. `/proc` can't be mounted with `hidepid` (no `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`), so process *command
lines* stay visible to every uid — which is why prompts/system prompts never go into argv. Preview ports:
chains `NX_PSRC` (packets *from* ports 4100-4199 of a sandbox listener, incl. the SYN-ACK) and `NX_PDST` (sandbox
connections *to* local ports 4100-4199) are jumped to before the established/loopback accepts and end in
`REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset` for uids 20001-39999; `net-claim` (on every run/preview start, with the port the
app assigned) inserts `RETURN` rules for the owner. So a sandbox can neither reach another project's dev server
nor squat another project's port (nobody, incl. the app proxy, can get a response from it); `preview/start`
also refuses to adopt a listener owned by another sandbox (409). Internet egress is unchanged.

**Why not bubblewrap / namespaces?** Inside this container unprivileged user namespaces are denied (Docker's
default seccomp profile blocks `unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER)`, AppArmor `docker-default` denies `mount`, and the host
sets `kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1`); bwrap would need `CAP_SYS_ADMIN` or
`seccomp=unconfined`+`apparmor=unconfined`, which weakens the host boundary far more than it gains. Plain
uid/gid separation + ACLs + no_new_privs + empty bounding set needs no extra container privileges.

**Known gaps (not isolated):** process command lines (`ps`) of other projects (e.g. Bash tool commands) are
visible; abstract unix sockets and `/dev/shm` objects created world-accessible by a tool are shared; CPU/memory/
pids are only limited per container; the app container (uid 1000, ACL) and claudebox server can access every
project by design (they enforce permissions in code; path checks are realpath-based); `/workspace/library`
(future) is meant to be world-readable. Sandboxed runs have no sudo/apt.

**Multi-project runs (Nexus Chat, prepared).** The app computes `sandbox = {uid: 30000+n, gid: same, groups:
[that uid, <gid of every project the user may access>…]}` and sends `cwd` (under `/workspace/.nexus/`) +
`addDirs` (those projects' dirs); claudebox validates only ranges/paths, creates the identity's home and the
helper puts the gids into the supplementary groups. Files created in a project by such a run get the project's
group (setgid) and stay accessible to the project's own uid.

**Escape hatch.** `SANDBOX_MODE=off` (compose env, restart claudebox): everything runs as uid 1000 again
(sudo per `CLAUDE_SUDO`); runs still use the per-project home for sessions when it exists. Switch back any time;
`setup` is idempotent.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| GET  | `/health` | `{status, activeRequests, version, claudeVersion, authMode, activeRuns, queuedRuns, maxConcurrent, firewallMode, autoPermissionMode}`. `authMode` is `oauth` \| `api_key` \| `credentials` \| `none`. |
| POST | `/v2/run` | Start a run; the response **is** the SSE stream (see below). |
| GET  | `/v2/run/:runId/events?fromSeq=N` | SSE: replay buffered events with `seq >= N` (inclusive, default 1), then follow live. Also honours the standard `Last-Event-ID` header (resumes at `id+1`) when `fromSeq` is absent. Ends immediately after replay if the run is finished. 404 if the run is unknown/expired. |
| GET  | `/v2/run/:runId` (alias `/v2/runs/:runId`) | Run info JSON (see `GET /v2/runs`). |
| POST | `/v2/abort` | `{runId}` → kills the run's whole process group (SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 4 s). Queued runs are just dequeued. → `{ok, runId, found, status}` (`status: "aborting"` for a running run). 404 if unknown. |
| GET  | `/v2/runs` | `{runs:[RunInfo], running, queued, retained, maxConcurrent}` — active (queued + running) runs. `?all=1` includes finished runs still retained. |
| POST | `/v2/preview/start` | `{projectSlug, port, command?}` → PreviewStatus (200) / 400 / 409 (port busy) / 422 (cannot detect a command). |
| POST | `/v2/preview/stop` | `{projectSlug, port?}` → `{stopped, ...PreviewStatus}`. Also kills any *unmanaged* process listening on the port (e.g. a dev server Claude started via Bash), except running Claude runs. |
| GET  | `/v2/preview/status?projectSlug=&port=` | PreviewStatus. `port` optional (defaults to the managed port). |
| GET  | `/v2/previews` | `{previews:[PreviewStatus]}` |
| POST | `/v2/git/<op>` | Git layer for branches/checkpoints (see "Git" below). |
| POST | `/v2/sandbox/setup` | `{projectSlug, sandbox, force?}` → `{ok, heavy, uid, gid}`: create/repair a project's sandbox (see "Sandbox"). Idempotent; `heavy: true` = first-time tree normalization + session migration ran. |

All preview endpoints accept an optional `worktree` (body or query): the preview then runs in the
branch worktree `$PROJECTS_DIR/.branches/<slug>/<worktree>` under the **preview key** `<slug>--<worktree>`
(`BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>--<worktree>/`, static prefix likewise). `PreviewStatus.projectSlug` is the key.

`RunInfo = {runId, projectSlug, status: queued|running|done|error|aborted, mode, model, sessionId, pid, createdAt, startedAt, endedAt, exitCode, lastSeq, firstSeq, subscribers}` (times are epoch ms).

`PreviewStatus = {projectSlug, running, managed, listening, port, pid, kind: "process"|"static"|null, command, startedAt, exitCode, logTail: string[] (≤200 lines)}`.
`running = managed || listening` — `listening` comes from a TCP connect probe to `127.0.0.1:<port>` (and `::1`),
so a server Claude started itself is reported as running (with `managed: false`).

Errors are JSON `{error: "message"}` with an appropriate status.

### POST /v2/run body

```json
{
  "runId": "uuid (optional; generated if absent)  ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$",
  "prompt": "string",
  "projectSlug": "my-app",              // ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$ ; cwd = $PROJECTS_DIR/<slug> (created if missing)
  "sessionId": "claude session id | null",   // → --resume
  "model": "opus|sonnet|haiku|<full id>",    // → --model
  "mode": "auto|edit|plan|ask",              // default auto
  "thinking": "off|normal|max",              // → env MAX_THINKING_TOKENS 0 / 8000 / 32000 (unset = CLI default)
  "effort": "low|medium|high|xhigh|max",     // optional → --effort
  "attachments": ["/workspace/uploads/<id>/<file>"],
  "appendSystemPrompt": "string",            // → --append-system-prompt
  "maxTurns": 50,                            // → --max-turns
  "previewPort": 4123,                       // 4100-4199 → env PORT/HOST/BASE_PATH for Claude's shell
  "worktree": "feature_login",               // optional: run in .branches/<slug>/<worktree> (must exist), BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>--<worktree>/
  "authToken": "optional per-run token",
  "autocompactTokens": 80000,                // optional; 0/absent = CLI default ("auto"). See below.
  "agents": {"code-reviewer": {"description": "…", "prompt": "…", "tools": ["Read","Grep"], "model": "sonnet"}},
  "agent": "code-reviewer",                  // optional lead agent (must be a key of `agents` when given)
  "sandbox": {"uid": 20007, "gid": 20007, "groups": [20007], "home": "/workspace/.sandbox-homes/20007"},
                                             // identity the run executes as (SANDBOX_MODE=strict); computed by the app
  "cwd": "/workspace/.nexus/<user>",         // multi-project runs only (requires `sandbox`): scratch cwd instead of the project dir
  "addDirs": ["/workspace/projects/a", "/workspace/projects/b"]   // multi-project runs: extra --add-dir project dirs
}
```

* `autocompactTokens` is the context size (tokens) at which auto-compaction fires. The CLI's
  `--autocompact` takes a *window* (100k–1M) and compacts at `window − 13k`, so claudebox passes
  `--autocompact <tokens+13000>`; below 87k it passes `--autocompact 100000` plus
  `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=<tokens/1000>` (percent of the 100k window → threshold = tokens).
  The model's own context window still caps it. Valid: 0 or 10 000–987 000.
* `agents` → `--agents <json>` (custom subagents; keys `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$`, value
  `{description, prompt, tools?: string[] (omit = inherit all), model?: alias|full id|"inherit"}`).
  JSON larger than 32 KiB is written to a temp file (`--agents <path>`, allowed with `-p`) that is
  deleted when the run ends. In `edit` mode the `Agent` tool is added to `--allowedTools` when agents are passed.
* `agent` → `--agent <name>`: runs the main session *as* that agent (its prompt/tools/model).
* `--forward-subagent-text` is always passed when the CLI supports it (`FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT=0` disables):
  subagent text/thinking is forwarded as `text`/`thinking` events **tagged with `parentId`** (never merged
  into the main answer, no `block_end`).
* Manual compaction: send the prompt `/compact [instructions]` with `sessionId` (→ `--resume`).

* Attachments must resolve inside `$UPLOADS_DIR` or the project dir; each is appended to the
  prompt as `[Attached file: <path> — use Read tool]`. Sandboxed runs: files under `$UPLOADS_DIR` are
  first **copied** into `<sandbox home>/uploads/<uploadId>/<file>` (the run can never see `$UPLOADS_DIR`
  itself, which sits under the 0700 dir `/workspace/.private`), the prompt references the copies and
  `--add-dir <home>/uploads` is passed. Unsandboxed (`SANDBOX_MODE=off`): `--add-dir $UPLOADS_DIR`.
* `authToken` overrides the container env for that run: tokens starting with `sk-ant-api` are set
  as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` removed); anything else (e.g. `sk-ant-oat01-…`
  from `claude setup-token`) is set as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` removed).
* Child env: `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` and the server's `PORT` are removed (sandboxed runs also get their own
  `HOME`, `PATH`, `TMPDIR`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX` from the helper — see "Sandbox"). With `previewPort`:
  `PORT=<previewPort> HOST=0.0.0.0 BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>/ NXEON_PREVIEW_PORT=<port>`.
  Always: `NXEON_PROJECT_SLUG`, `NXEON_RUN_ID`.
* Errors: 400 validation, 401 auth, 409 duplicate `runId` (use the events endpoint to reattach).
* Concurrency: at most `MAX_CONCURRENT` (default 4) runs execute; further runs wait silently in a
  FIFO queue (the SSE stream is open but emits nothing until the run starts; status `queued`).
* **Client disconnect never kills a run.** Only `/v2/abort` does. Reattach with
  `GET /v2/run/:runId/events?fromSeq=<lastSeenSeq+1>`. Event buffers (≤50 000 events per run) are kept
  for 30 minutes after completion (`RUN_RETENTION_MS`).

## CLI invocation

```
claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages \
       --permission-prompts none \
       [--model M] [--resume SID] [--max-turns N] [--effort E] [--append-system-prompt S] \
       --add-dir $UPLOADS_DIR [--autocompact W] [--agents JSON|FILE] [--agent NAME] [--forward-subagent-text] \
       <mode flags>  -- "<prompt>"
```

Sandboxed (strict) runs are launched as
`sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox exec --uid U --gid G [--groups ...] --cwd <cwd> --env-file <f> -- claude <args>`
and differ in three ways so nothing project-specific shows up in other uids' `ps`/`/proc/<pid>/cmdline`:
the prompt is written to **stdin** (no `-- "<prompt>"`), the system prompt goes through
`--append-system-prompt-file <home>/.nxeon/runs/<runId>/system-prompt.md`, and `--agents` always uses a file
there (deleted when the run ends); `--add-dir <home>/uploads` replaces `--add-dir $UPLOADS_DIR`.

Unsandboxed `stdin` is `/dev/null`; the child is spawned `detached` (own process group = pid) so abort can
kill the whole tree (sandboxed: the process group of the `sudo` launcher, signalled by the helper as the run's uid). `--permission-prompts none` (auto-deny anything that would prompt) is only passed when
the installed CLI advertises it in `--help` (feature detection at startup).

#!/bin/bash
# nx-sandbox — Nxeon per-project sandbox helper (installed root-owned at /usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox).
#
# The claudebox server runs as uid 1000 (`claude`) and may run ONLY this program as root:
#   /etc/sudoers.d/nx-sandbox:  claude ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox
# Every argument is validated strictly; paths and id ranges are fixed constants (sudo resets the env).
#
#   exec      --uid U --gid G [--groups G1,G2,...] --cwd DIR [--env-file F] [--setenv K=V]... -- CMD [ARGS...]
#             Run CMD as U:G (+groups) with no capabilities, an empty bounding set and no_new_privs,
#             HOME=/workspace/.sandbox-homes/U, umask 007, a clean environment, cwd entered AFTER the uid switch.
#   kill      --uid U --pgid P [--signal TERM|KILL|INT|HUP]   signal uid U's processes in process group P
#   kill-port --uid U --port N [--signal S] [--protect PG1,PG2]  kill uid-U listeners on port N (+ their group)
#   setup     --uid U --slug S [--force]   project dir + branches dir + home: owner/group/ACLs, session migration
#   fixperms  --uid U --slug S             cheap post-run normalization (owner U, group G, g+rw, o-rwx)
#   net-claim --port N --uids U1[,U2]      only these sandbox uids may serve / connect to preview port N
#   home      --uid U --gid G              ensure the home of an identity (e.g. a Nexus user) exists
#
# Identity model: project sandbox uid == gid == 20000 + projects.sandbox_id (20001-29999);
# per-user Nexus identities use 30000-39999. Project dirs are 1000:G mode 2770 + ACLs.
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export LC_ALL=C

PROJECTS=/workspace/projects
HOMES=/workspace/.sandbox-homes
NEXUS=/workspace/.nexus
LIBRARY=/workspace/library
OLD_CLAUDE=/home/claude/.claude
ENV_DIR=/run/nx-sandbox
SERVER_UID=1000
UID_MIN=20001
UID_MAX=39999
PROJECT_UID_MAX=29999
PORT_MIN=${NX_PORT_MIN:-4100}
PORT_MAX=${NX_PORT_MAX:-4199}
# sudo resets the env, so NX_PORT_* only apply when root runs this directly (tests); clamp anyway.
[[ $PORT_MIN =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ && $PORT_MAX =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || { PORT_MIN=4100; PORT_MAX=4199; }
LOCK=/run/nx-sandbox.lock
SANDBOX_PATH_SUFFIX=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

die() { echo "nx-sandbox: $*" >&2; exit 2; }

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || die "must run as root (via sudo)"
if [ -n "${SUDO_UID:-}" ] && [ "$SUDO_UID" != "$SERVER_UID" ]; then die "caller uid $SUDO_UID not allowed"; fi

is_int() { [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9]{1,9}$ ]]; }
need_uid() { is_int "$1" && [ "$1" -ge "$UID_MIN" ] && [ "$1" -le "$UID_MAX" ] || die "invalid sandbox id '$1' (${UID_MIN}-${UID_MAX})"; }
need_project_uid() { need_uid "$1"; [ "$1" -le "$PROJECT_UID_MAX" ] || die "not a project sandbox id: $1"; }
need_slug() { [[ $1 =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$ ]] || die "invalid slug '$1'"; }
need_port() { is_int "$1" && [ "$1" -ge "$PORT_MIN" ] && [ "$1" -le "$PORT_MAX" ] || die "invalid port '$1'"; }
# A clean absolute path: no '.', '..', empty components or odd characters.
clean_path() { [[ $1 =~ ^(/[A-Za-z0-9._@+-]+)+$ ]] && [[ ! $1 =~ /\.\.?(/|$) ]]; }

signal_ok() { case "$1" in TERM|KILL|INT|HUP) return 0 ;; *) die "invalid signal '$1'" ;; esac; }

# Run a command as a sandbox uid with no privileges. Root here lacks CAP_SYS_PTRACE (docker default), so
# /proc/<pid>/fd of sandbox processes is only readable as that uid — and signalling as that uid can never
# hit anyone else's processes.
as_uid() { # uid cmd...
  local u=$1; shift
  setpriv --reuid="$u" --regid="$u" --clear-groups --inh-caps=-all --bounding-set=-all --no-new-privs -- "$@"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- identities / dirs

ensure_identity() { # uid gid [groups...]
  local u=$1 g=$2 x missing=0; shift 2
  getent passwd "$u" >/dev/null || missing=1
  for x in "$g" "$@"; do getent group "$x" >/dev/null || missing=1; done
  [ "$missing" = 1 ] || return 0
  (
    flock -w 10 9 || true
    for x in "$g" "$@"; do getent group "$x" >/dev/null || groupadd -g "$x" "nx$x" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done
    getent passwd "$u" >/dev/null || useradd -u "$u" -g "$g" -M -N -d "$HOMES/$u" -s /bin/bash "nx$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  ) 9>"$LOCK"
}

# Top-level dir of a sandbox area: owned by the server uid (so the sandbox cannot chmod it open),
# group G, setgid, no access for others; ACLs keep uid 1000 (app + claudebox server) in, and make
# everything created inside group-writable and accessible to uid 1000.
acl_top() { # dir gid
  local d=$1 g=$2
  [ -L "$d" ] && die "refusing symlink $d"
  mkdir -p "$d"
  chown "$SERVER_UID:$g" "$d"
  chmod 2770 "$d"
  setfacl -m "u:$SERVER_UID:rwx,g::rwx,m::rwx,o::---" "$d"
  setfacl -d -m "u::rwx,u:$SERVER_UID:rwx,g::rwx,m::rwx,o::---" "$d"
}

# Full normalization of everything below a top dir (first-time migration / --force).
normalize_tree() { # dir uid gid
  local d=$1 u=$2 g=$3
  [ -d "$d" ] || return 0
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev -exec chown -h "$u:$g" {} +
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev -type d -exec chmod g+rwxs,o-rwx {} +
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev -type f -exec chmod g+rw,o-rwx {} +
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev -type d -exec setfacl -m "u:$SERVER_UID:rwx,m::rwx" {} + \
    -exec setfacl -d -m "u::rwx,u:$SERVER_UID:rwx,g::rwx,m::rwx,o::---" {} +
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev -type f -exec setfacl -m "u:$SERVER_UID:rwX,m::rwX" {} +
}

# Cheap normalization after a run: only touches entries that drifted.
fix_tree() { # dir uid gid
  local d=$1 u=$2 g=$3
  [ -d "$d" ] && [ ! -L "$d" ] || return 0
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev \( ! -user "$u" -o ! -group "$g" \) -exec chown -h "$u:$g" {} + 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev -type d ! -perm -2070 -exec chmod g+rwxs {} + 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev -type f ! -path '*/.git/objects/*' ! -perm -060 -exec chmod g+rw {} + 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$d" -mindepth 1 -xdev ! -type l -perm /007 -exec chmod o-rwx {} + 2>/dev/null || true
}

ensure_home() { # uid gid
  local u=$1 g=$2 h="$HOMES/$1"
  if [ ! -d "$h/tmp" ] || [ "$(stat -c %g "$h")" != "$g" ]; then
    acl_top "$h" "$g"
    mkdir -p "$h/tmp" "$h/.claude"
    chown "$u:$g" "$h/tmp" "$h/.claude"
    chmod 2770 "$h/tmp" "$h/.claude"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exec

cmd_exec() {
  local uid="" gid="" groups="" cwd="" envfile=""
  local -a setenv=()
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --uid) uid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --gid) gid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --groups) groups=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --cwd) cwd=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --env-file) envfile=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --setenv) setenv+=("${2:-}"); shift 2 ;;
      --) shift; break ;;
      *) die "exec: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  [ $# -gt 0 ] || die "exec: missing command"
  need_uid "$uid"; need_uid "$gid"
  [ "$gid" = "$uid" ] || die "exec: gid must equal uid (grant project access via --groups)"
  local -a glist=("$gid")
  if [ -n "$groups" ]; then
    [[ $groups =~ ^[0-9]{1,9}(,[0-9]{1,9}){0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid --groups"
    IFS=, read -ra extra <<<"$groups"
    for g in "${extra[@]}"; do need_uid "$g"; [ "$g" = "$gid" ] || glist+=("$g"); done
  fi
  local gcsv; gcsv=$(IFS=,; echo "${glist[*]}")

  # cwd: a clean path inside the projects tree or a Nexus scratch dir, whose top-level sandbox dir
  # belongs to one of the run's groups (the chdir itself happens after the uid switch).
  clean_path "$cwd" || die "invalid --cwd"
  local top=""
  case "$cwd" in
    "$PROJECTS"/.branches/*) top=$(echo "$cwd" | cut -d/ -f1-5) ;;
    "$PROJECTS"/.*) die "cwd not allowed: $cwd" ;;
    "$PROJECTS"/*) top=$(echo "$cwd" | cut -d/ -f1-4) ;;
    "$NEXUS"/*) top=$(echo "$cwd" | cut -d/ -f1-4) ;;
    *) die "cwd must be under $PROJECTS or $NEXUS" ;;
  esac
  [ -d "$top" ] && [ ! -L "$top" ] || die "sandbox dir missing: $top"
  local tg; tg=$(stat -c %g "$top")
  local ok=0
  for g in "${glist[@]}"; do [ "$g" = "$tg" ] && ok=1; done
  [ "$ok" = 1 ] || die "cwd $top is not owned by the sandbox groups"

  ensure_identity "$uid" "$gid" "${glist[@]}"
  ensure_home "$uid" "$gid"
  local home="$HOMES/$uid"

  local -a envs=(
    "HOME=$home" "USER=nx$uid" "LOGNAME=nx$uid" "SHELL=/bin/bash" "LANG=C.UTF-8"
    "PATH=$home/.npm-global/bin:$home/.local/bin:$SANDBOX_PATH_SUFFIX"
    "TMPDIR=$home/tmp" "TMP=$home/tmp" "TEMP=$home/tmp"
    "NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX=$home/.npm-global" "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$home/.claude"
    "XDG_CACHE_HOME=$home/.cache" "XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$home/.config"
  )
  if [ -n "$envfile" ]; then
    clean_path "$envfile" || die "invalid --env-file"
    case "$envfile" in "$ENV_DIR"/*) ;; *) die "--env-file must be under $ENV_DIR" ;; esac
    [ -f "$envfile" ] && [ ! -L "$envfile" ] || die "env file missing"
    [ "$(stat -c %u "$envfile")" = "$SERVER_UID" ] || die "env file has the wrong owner"
    while IFS= read -r -d '' kv; do
      [[ ${kv%%=*} =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$ ]] && [[ $kv == *=* ]] || die "invalid env entry"
      envs+=("$kv")
    done <"$envfile"
    rm -f "$envfile"
  fi
  for kv in "${setenv[@]}"; do
    [[ ${kv%%=*} =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$ ]] && [[ $kv == *=* ]] || die "invalid --setenv"
    envs+=("$kv")
  done
  envs+=("HOME=$home") # never overridable

  umask 007
  exec setpriv --reuid="$uid" --regid="$gid" --groups="$gcsv" \
    --inh-caps=-all --ambient-caps=-all --bounding-set=-all --no-new-privs \
    -- /usr/bin/env -i -C "$cwd" "${envs[@]}" "$@"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- kill

cmd_kill() {
  local uid="" pgid="" sig=TERM
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --uid) uid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --pgid) pgid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --signal) sig=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      *) die "kill: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  need_uid "$uid"; is_int "$pgid" && [ "$pgid" -gt 1 ] || die "invalid --pgid"; signal_ok "$sig"
  # kill(-pgid) as the sandbox uid signals exactly that uid's members of the group.
  as_uid "$uid" /bin/kill -s "$sig" -- "-$pgid" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Runs as the sandbox uid: find its LISTEN sockets on the port, kill the owning process groups.
KILL_PORT_SCRIPT='
set -u
port=$1 sig=$2 protect=$3 me=$(id -u)
hex=$(printf "%04X" "$port")
inodes=$(awk -v h=":$hex" -v u="$me" '"'"'FNR>1 && $4=="0A" && substr($2, length($2)-4)==h && $8==u {print $10}'"'"' /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null | sort -u)
n=0
for ino in $inodes; do
  for f in $(find /proc/[0-9]*/fd -maxdepth 1 -lname "socket:\[$ino\]" 2>/dev/null); do
    pid=$(echo "$f" | cut -d/ -f3)
    read -r s </proc/$pid/stat 2>/dev/null || continue
    rest=${s##*) }; read -r _ _ pg _ <<<"$rest"
    if [ -n "$pg" ] && [ "$pg" -gt 1 ] && [[ ",$protect," != *",$pg,"* ]]; then
      kill -s "$sig" -- "-$pg" 2>/dev/null && n=$((n + 1))
    else
      kill -s "$sig" "$pid" 2>/dev/null && n=$((n + 1))
    fi
  done
done
echo "$n"
'

cmd_kill_port() {
  local uid="" port="" sig=TERM protect=""
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --uid) uid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --port) port=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --signal) sig=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --protect) protect=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      *) die "kill-port: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  need_uid "$uid"; need_port "$port"; signal_ok "$sig"
  [ -z "$protect" ] || [[ $protect =~ ^[0-9]{1,9}(,[0-9]{1,9}){0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid --protect"
  as_uid "$uid" /bin/bash -c "$KILL_PORT_SCRIPT" nx-kill-port "$port" "$sig" "$protect"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup / fixperms

# Claude Code keys its session store by cwd: every non-alphanumeric char becomes '-'.
escape_cwd() { echo "$1" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/-/g'; }

cmd_setup() {
  local uid="" slug="" force=0
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --uid) uid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --slug) slug=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --force) force=1; shift ;;
      *) die "setup: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  need_project_uid "$uid"; need_slug "$slug"
  local gid=$uid P="$PROJECTS/$slug" B="$PROJECTS/.branches/$slug" H="$HOMES/$uid"
  [ -L "$P" ] && die "project dir is a symlink"
  [ -L "$B" ] && die "branches dir is a symlink"
  (
    flock -w 600 8 || die "setup lock timeout"
    ensure_identity "$uid" "$gid"
    # Shared roots: traverse-only for sandboxes (no listing of other projects / homes).
    for r in "$PROJECTS" "$PROJECTS/.branches" "$HOMES"; do
      mkdir -p "$r"; chown "$SERVER_UID:$SERVER_UID" "$r"; chmod 0711 "$r"
    done
    local marker="$H/.nxeon-setup" want="v1 $slug"
    local heavy=$force
    [ -d "$P" ] && [ "$(stat -c %g "$P")" = "$gid" ] || heavy=1
    [ "$(cat "$marker" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$want" ] || heavy=1
    if [ -e "$P" ] && [ "$heavy" = 1 ]; then
      # refuse to hand another sandbox's dir to this uid
      local cur; cur=$(stat -c %g "$P")
      if [ "$cur" -ge "$UID_MIN" ] && [ "$cur" -le "$PROJECT_UID_MAX" ] && [ "$cur" != "$gid" ] && [ "$force" != 1 ]; then
        die "$P already belongs to sandbox $cur"
      fi
    fi
    acl_top "$P" "$gid"
    acl_top "$B" "$gid"
    ensure_home "$uid" "$gid"
    if [ "$heavy" = 1 ]; then
      normalize_tree "$P" "$uid" "$gid"
      normalize_tree "$B" "$uid" "$gid"
      # Migrate Claude sessions of this project's cwds (main + branch worktrees) from the shared store.
      if [ -d "$OLD_CLAUDE/projects" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$H/.claude/projects"
        local cwds=("$P")
        for w in "$B"/*/; do [ -d "$w" ] && cwds+=("${w%/}"); done
        for c in "${cwds[@]}"; do
          local esc; esc=$(escape_cwd "$c")
          [ -d "$OLD_CLAUDE/projects/$esc" ] && [ ! -L "$OLD_CLAUDE/projects/$esc" ] || continue
          cp -a -u "$OLD_CLAUDE/projects/$esc" "$H/.claude/projects/"
        done
      fi
      if [ -f "$OLD_CLAUDE/.claude.json" ] && [ ! -e "$H/.claude/.claude.json" ]; then
        cp "$OLD_CLAUDE/.claude.json" "$H/.claude/.claude.json"
      fi
      normalize_tree "$H" "$uid" "$gid"
      echo "$want" >"$marker"
      chown "$SERVER_UID:$gid" "$marker"; chmod 0640 "$marker"
    fi
    echo "{\"ok\":true,\"heavy\":$([ "$heavy" = 1 ] && echo true || echo false),\"uid\":$uid,\"gid\":$gid}"
  ) 8>"$LOCK.setup.$uid"
}

cmd_fixperms() {
  local uid="" slug=""
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --uid) uid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --slug) slug=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      *) die "fixperms: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  need_project_uid "$uid"; need_slug "$slug"
  local gid=$uid d
  for d in "$PROJECTS/$slug" "$PROJECTS/.branches/$slug"; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && [ ! -L "$d" ] || continue
    [ "$(stat -c %g "$d")" = "$gid" ] || die "$d does not belong to sandbox $uid"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- network

# Chains (created by the entrypoint): NX_PSRC filters packets *from* preview ports (SYN-ACKs/replies of
# listeners), NX_PDST filters sandbox connections *to* local preview ports. Each claimed port gets
# RETURN rules for its owner uid(s); the chains end in REJECT for every other sandbox uid.
cmd_net_claim() {
  local port="" uids=""
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --port) port=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --uids) uids=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      *) die "net-claim: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  need_port "$port"
  [[ $uids =~ ^[0-9]{1,9}(,[0-9]{1,9}){0,15}$ ]] || die "invalid --uids"
  IFS=, read -ra ul <<<"$uids"
  for u in "${ul[@]}"; do need_uid "$u"; done
  command -v iptables >/dev/null || die "iptables missing"
  (
    flock -w 10 7 || die "net lock timeout"
    for ipt in iptables ip6tables; do
      $ipt -w -S NX_PSRC >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue
      for chain in NX_PSRC NX_PDST; do
        local flag=--sport; [ "$chain" = NX_PDST ] && flag=--dport
        # drop existing rules for this port
        local rules
        rules=$($ipt -w -S "$chain" | grep -E -- "$flag $port( |\$)" || true)
        while read -ra rule; do
          [ "${#rule[@]}" -gt 0 ] && [ "${rule[0]}" = "-A" ] || continue
          rule[0]=-D
          $ipt -w "${rule[@]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        done <<<"$rules"
        for u in "${ul[@]}"; do
          $ipt -w -I "$chain" 1 -p tcp "$flag" "$port" -m owner --uid-owner "$u" -j RETURN
        done
      done
    done
  ) 7>"$LOCK.net"
  echo ok
}

cmd_home() {
  local uid="" gid=""
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --uid) uid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --gid) gid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      *) die "home: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  need_uid "$uid"; need_uid "$gid"
  [ "$gid" = "$uid" ] || die "home: gid must equal uid"
  local h="$HOMES/$uid"
  [ -L "$h" ] && die "home is a symlink"
  if [ -d "$h" ]; then
    local cur; cur=$(stat -c %g "$h")
    [ "$cur" = "$gid" ] || [ "$cur" = "$SERVER_UID" ] || [ "$cur" = 0 ] || die "$h belongs to group $cur"
  fi
  mkdir -p "$HOMES"; chown "$SERVER_UID:$SERVER_UID" "$HOMES"; chmod 0711 "$HOMES"
  ensure_identity "$uid" "$gid"
  ensure_home "$uid" "$gid"
  echo ok
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main

sub=${1:-}
[ $# -gt 0 ] && shift
case "$sub" in
  exec) cmd_exec "$@" ;;
  kill) cmd_kill "$@" ;;
  kill-port) cmd_kill_port "$@" ;;
  setup) cmd_setup "$@" ;;
  fixperms) cmd_fixperms "$@" ;;
  net-claim) cmd_net_claim "$@" ;;
  home) cmd_home "$@" ;;
  *) die "usage: nx-sandbox exec|kill|kill-port|setup|fixperms|net-claim|home ..." ;;
esac
"use strict";
// Per-project sandboxing (see PROTOCOL.md "Sandbox"). The claudebox server stays uid 1000 and runs
// sandboxed processes (Claude runs, preview dev servers, git) through the root-owned helper
// /usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox via `sudo -n` (the only sudo rule uid 1000 has in strict mode).
//
// Identity: project sandbox uid == gid == 20000 + projects.sandbox_id (20001-29999); per-user Nexus
// identities 30000-39999. HOME = /workspace/.sandbox-homes/<uid> (Claude config, sessions, caches, TMPDIR).

const { execFile, execFileSync } = require("child_process");
const crypto = require("crypto");
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const UID_MIN = 20001;
const UID_MAX = 39999;
const PROJECT_UID_MAX = 29999;
const SLUG_RE = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$/;
const ENV_KEY_RE = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$/;
/** Never forwarded into a sandbox: the wrapper sets these itself (or they are server secrets). */
const ENV_DROP = new Set([
  "CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY", "HOME", "PATH", "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", "NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX", "USER", "LOGNAME", "PWD", "OLDPWD",
  "SHLVL", "_", "TMPDIR", "TMP", "TEMP", "MAIL", "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "UPLOADS_DIR", "PROJECTS_DIR",
  "SANDBOX_MODE", "SUDO_USER", "SUDO_UID", "SUDO_GID", "SUDO_COMMAND", "CLAUDEBOX_ALLOW_NO_AUTH",
]);

const inRange = (n, max = UID_MAX) => Number.isInteger(n) && n >= UID_MIN && n <= max;

class SandboxError extends Error {
  constructor(status, message) {
    super(message);
    this.status = status;
  }
}

class Sandbox {
  constructor(config = {}) {
    this.config = {
      mode: "strict",
      wrapper: "/usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox",
      sudo: "sudo",
      projectsDir: "/workspace/projects",
      homesDir: "/workspace/.sandbox-homes",
      nexusDir: "/workspace/.nexus",
      envDir: "/run/nx-sandbox",
      /** extra env for the sudo invocation itself (tests only; sudo resets the env anyway) */
      helperEnv: {},
      log: () => {},
      ...config,
    };
    if (!["strict", "off"].includes(this.config.mode)) throw new Error(`Invalid SANDBOX_MODE '${this.config.mode}' (strict|off)`);
    this.ready = new Map(); // slug -> uid whose setup ran in this process
    this.setupInFlight = new Map();
  }

  get strict() {
    return this.config.mode === "strict";
  }

  /** Is the root helper installed (strict mode needs it)? */
  available() {
    try {
      const st = fs.statSync(this.config.wrapper);
      return st.isFile() && st.uid === 0;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  homeOf(uid) {
    return path.join(this.config.homesDir, String(uid));
  }

  /**
   * Validate an app-supplied sandbox spec {uid, gid, groups?, home?}. Only ranges and paths are checked
   * here: the app is authoritative for which projects a run may access.
   * @returns {{spec} | {error}}
   */
  validateSpec(raw) {
    if (raw == null) return { spec: null };
    if (typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw)) return { error: "Invalid sandbox (object expected)" };
    const uid = Number(raw.uid);
    const gid = raw.gid == null ? uid : Number(raw.gid);
    if (!inRange(uid)) return { error: `Invalid sandbox.uid (${UID_MIN}-${UID_MAX})` };
    if (!inRange(gid)) return { error: `Invalid sandbox.gid (${UID_MIN}-${UID_MAX})` };
    if (gid !== uid) return { error: "sandbox.gid must equal sandbox.uid (grant extra projects via groups)" };
    const groups = [gid];
    if (raw.groups != null) {
      if (!Array.isArray(raw.groups) || raw.groups.length > 64) return { error: "Invalid sandbox.groups" };
      for (const g of raw.groups) {
        const n = Number(g);
        if (!inRange(n)) return { error: `Invalid sandbox group ${g}` };
        if (!groups.includes(n)) groups.push(n);
      }
    }
    const home = this.homeOf(uid);
    if (raw.home != null && raw.home !== home) return { error: `sandbox.home must be ${home}` };
    return { spec: { uid, gid, groups, home } };
  }

  /** Project spec derived from the project dir's group (the on-disk source of truth after setup). */
  specFromDir(slug) {
    if (!SLUG_RE.test(slug || "")) return null;
    try {
      const gid = fs.statSync(path.join(this.config.projectsDir, slug)).gid;
      if (!inRange(gid, PROJECT_UID_MAX)) return null;
      return { uid: gid, gid, groups: [gid], home: this.homeOf(gid) };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /** Spec for a project-scoped operation: explicit (validated, must match the dir once set up) or derived. */
  resolveProject(slug, raw) {
    const v = this.validateSpec(raw);
    if (v.error) throw new SandboxError(400, v.error);
    const fromDir = this.specFromDir(slug);
    if (v.spec) {
      if (v.spec.uid > PROJECT_UID_MAX) throw new SandboxError(400, "Project operations need a project sandbox uid (20001-29999)");
      if (fromDir && fromDir.gid !== v.spec.gid) throw new SandboxError(409, `Project '${slug}' belongs to sandbox ${fromDir.gid}, not ${v.spec.gid}`);
      return v.spec;
    }
    return fromDir;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ root helper calls

  _helperEnv() {
    return { PATH: process.env.PATH || "/usr/bin:/bin", ...this.config.helperEnv };
  }

  _run(args, { timeoutMs = 120_000 } = {}) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      execFile(this.config.sudo, ["-n", this.config.wrapper, ...args], { timeout: timeoutMs, maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024, env: this._helperEnv() }, (err, stdout, stderr) => {
        if (err) return reject(new SandboxError(500, `nx-sandbox ${args[0]} failed: ${String(stderr || err.message).trim().slice(0, 500)}`));
        resolve(String(stdout));
      });
    });
  }

  _runSync(args) {
    try {
      return execFileSync(this.config.sudo, ["-n", this.config.wrapper, ...args], { timeout: 15_000, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"], env: this._helperEnv() }).toString();
    } catch (err) {
      this.config.log("warn", "nx-sandbox call failed", { op: args[0], error: String(err.stderr || err.message).slice(0, 300) });
      return "";
    }
  }

  /**
   * Make sure a project's dirs/home are owned by its sandbox (idempotent). The first call per process does
   * the real work (the helper itself skips the tree walk + session migration when already done).
   */
  async ensureProject(slug, spec, { force = false } = {}) {
    if (!this.strict || !spec) return { ok: true, skipped: true };
    if (!SLUG_RE.test(slug)) throw new SandboxError(400, "Invalid projectSlug");
    if (spec.uid > PROJECT_UID_MAX || spec.uid !== spec.gid) throw new SandboxError(400, "Invalid project sandbox");
    if (!force && this.ready.get(slug) === spec.uid) return { ok: true, cached: true };
    const key = `${slug}:${spec.uid}:${force}`;
    let p = this.setupInFlight.get(key);
    if (!p) {
      p = (async () => {
        const out = await this._run(["setup", "--uid", String(spec.uid), "--slug", slug, ...(force ? ["--force"] : [])], { timeoutMs: 600_000 });
        this.ready.set(slug, spec.uid);
        let r = { ok: true };
        try {
          r = JSON.parse(out.trim().split("\n").pop());
        } catch {
          /* keep default */
        }
        if (r.heavy) this.config.log("info", "sandbox setup", { slug, uid: spec.uid, heavy: true });
        return r;
      })().finally(() => this.setupInFlight.delete(key));
      this.setupInFlight.set(key, p);
    }
    return p;
  }

  /** Make sure a (Nexus) identity's home exists before the server writes per-run files into it. */
  async ensureHome(spec) {
    if (!this.strict || !spec) return;
    if (this.ready.get(`home:${spec.uid}`) === spec.gid) return;
    await this._run(["home", "--uid", String(spec.uid), "--gid", String(spec.gid)], { timeoutMs: 30_000 });
    this.ready.set(`home:${spec.uid}`, spec.gid);
  }

  /** Fire-and-forget post-run permission normalization of a project's trees. */
  fixperms(slug, spec) {
    if (!this.strict || !spec || spec.uid > PROJECT_UID_MAX) return Promise.resolve();
    return this._run(["fixperms", "--uid", String(spec.uid), "--slug", slug], { timeoutMs: 300_000 }).catch((err) =>
      this.config.log("warn", "fixperms failed", { slug, error: err.message }),
    );
  }

  /** Restrict local preview port `port` to these sandbox uids (iptables owner match). */
  netClaim(port, uids) {
    if (!this.strict || !uids.length) return Promise.resolve();
    return this._run(["net-claim", "--port", String(port), "--uids", uids.join(",")], { timeoutMs: 20_000 }).catch((err) =>
      this.config.log("warn", "net-claim failed", { port, error: err.message }),
    );
  }

# Nxeon Workspace — production stack (see SPEC.md §2)
#
#   Browser ─TLS─> Caddy (host :443) ─> 127.0.0.1:8080 ─> app ─> claudebox:3000 / :4100-4199
#                                                           └──> whisper:9000
#
# Only `app` is published, and only on host loopback (127.0.0.1:8080). Docker
# port publishing bypasses ufw, so nothing else may ever get a `ports:` entry.
#
# TRUST_PROXY: Caddy runs on the host and connects to 127.0.0.1:8080; docker-proxy
# forwards that into the `nxeon` network, so the app sees the peer address as the
# bridge GATEWAY (172.28.0.1), never 127.0.0.1. The subnet is pinned below so this
# value is deterministic. Only that single address is trusted to set X-Forwarded-For
# (claudebox/whisper live on the same subnet but must not be able to spoof it).
#
# Usage: deploy/up.sh   (or: sudo docker compose up -d --build)

name: nxeon

x-logging: &logging
  driver: json-file
  options:
    max-size: "10m"
    max-file: "3"

services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.app
    image: nxeon/app:latest
    container_name: nxeon-app
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: true
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "8080"
      HOST: 0.0.0.0
      CLAUDEBOX_URL: http://claudebox:3000
      WHISPER_URL: http://whisper:9000
      PROJECTS_DIR: /data/projects
      UPLOADS_DIR: /data/uploads
      DB_PATH: /data/db/nxeon.db
      CLAUDEBOX_PROJECTS_DIR: /workspace/projects
      CLAUDEBOX_UPLOADS_DIR: /workspace/.private/uploads
      TRUST_PROXY: 172.28.0.1/32
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./data/projects:/data/projects
      - ./data/uploads:/data/uploads
      - ./data/db:/data/db
    depends_on:
      claudebox:
        condition: service_started
      whisper:
        condition: service_started
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/health').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 30s
      retries: 3
    mem_limit: 1g
    pids_limit: 512
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    logging: *logging
    networks:
      nxeon:
        ipv4_address: 172.28.0.10

  claudebox:
    build:
      context: ./claudebox
    image: nxeon/claudebox:latest
    container_name: nxeon-claudebox
    restart: unless-stopped
    # NOT published to the host: reachable only from `app` over the nxeon network
    # (API :3000, preview servers :4100-4199).
    expose:
      - "3000"
      - "4100-4199"
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN   # entrypoint installs the egress firewall, then drops the cap
      - NET_RAW
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      FIREWALL_MODE: open
      MAX_CONCURRENT: "4"
      PROJECTS_DIR: /workspace/projects
      # Uploads sit under a 0700 dir: sandboxed runs only get copies of their own attachments.
      UPLOADS_DIR: /workspace/.private/uploads
      # strict = every project's runs/previews/git run as its own uid (see claudebox/PROTOCOL.md "Sandbox");
      # off = emergency fallback to the old shared-uid mode.
      SANDBOX_MODE: ${SANDBOX_MODE:-strict}
      PREVIEW_PORT_MIN: "4100"
      PREVIEW_PORT_MAX: "4199"
      # Secrets come from .env (empty values = not set):
      CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY: ${CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY:?CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY must be set in .env}
      CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN:-}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}
    volumes:
      - ./data/projects:/workspace/projects
      - ./data/uploads:/workspace/.private/uploads:ro
      - ./data/claude-home:/home/claude/.claude
      # per-project sandbox homes (Claude config + sessions, npm/pip caches, TMPDIR)
      - ./data/sandbox-homes:/workspace/.sandbox-homes
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/health >/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 30s
      retries: 3
    mem_limit: 4g
    memswap_limit: 5g
    pids_limit: 4096
    shm_size: 256m
    logging: *logging
    networks:
      nxeon:
        ipv4_address: 172.28.0.20

  whisper:
    build:
      context: ./whisper
    image: nxeon/whisper:latest
    container_name: nxeon-whisper
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: false   # image already runs tini as PID 1
    expose:
      - "9000"
    environment:
      WHISPER_MODEL: base        # base ≈ 2 s per 10 s clip on this VPS; "small" is more accurate but ~3.5x slower
      WHISPER_THREADS: "4"
      WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE: int8
      MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: "26214400"
      MAX_AUDIO_SECONDS: "300"
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"
    volumes:
      - ./data/whisper-models:/models
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:9000/health',timeout=4).status==200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 60s
      retries: 3
    mem_limit: 1536m
    pids_limit: 256
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=128m
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    logging: *logging
    networks:
      nxeon:
        ipv4_address: 172.28.0.30

networks:
  nxeon:
    name: nxeon
    driver: bridge
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.bridge.name: br-nxeon
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.28.0.0/24
          gateway: 172.28.0.1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Nxeon Workspace — build images and (re)start the stack, then wait for health.
#   deploy/up.sh                # build all + up
#   deploy/up.sh --no-build     # just (re)create containers
#   deploy/up.sh app            # build + restart only the given service(s)
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
ROOT=$PWD
DC=(sudo docker compose -f "$ROOT/docker-compose.yml" --project-directory "$ROOT")

BUILD=1
SERVICES=()
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --no-build) BUILD=0 ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,6p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) SERVICES+=("$a") ;;
  esac
done

log() { printf '\033[38;5;205m[nxeon]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { printf '\033[31m[nxeon] %s\033[0m\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

[ -f .env ] || die ".env missing (copy .env.example, fill secrets, chmod 600)"
[ "$(stat -c %a .env)" = "600" ] || { log "fixing .env permissions -> 600"; chmod 600 .env; }
[ -f Dockerfile.app ] || die "Dockerfile.app missing (app image cannot be built)"

# Bind-mount dirs must exist and be owned by uid 1000 (app + claudebox users).
# NOTE: never chown -R projects/ or sandbox-homes/: their contents belong to per-project sandbox uids/gids
# (claudebox SANDBOX_MODE=strict) and a recursive chown would break the isolation until the next setup.
for d in projects uploads db claude-home whisper-models backups sandbox-homes; do
  mkdir -p "data/$d"
done
for d in uploads db claude-home whisper-models backups; do
  if [ -n "$(find "data/$d" -maxdepth 1 \( -not -uid 1000 -o -not -gid 1000 \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    log "fixing ownership of data/$d -> 1000:1000"
    sudo chown -R 1000:1000 "data/$d"
  fi
done
for d in . projects sandbox-homes; do
  [ "$(stat -c %u:%g "data/$d")" = "1000:1000" ] || { log "fixing ownership of data/$d (top dir only)"; sudo chown 1000:1000 "data/$d"; }
done

if [ "$BUILD" = 1 ]; then
  log "building images ${SERVICES[*]:-(all)}"
  "${DC[@]}" build --pull "${SERVICES[@]}"
fi

log "starting containers"
"${DC[@]}" up -d --remove-orphans "${SERVICES[@]}"

# Wait for docker healthchecks.
wait_healthy() {
  local c=$1 timeout=${2:-180} s
  for ((i = 0; i < timeout; i += 3)); do
    s=$(sudo docker inspect -f '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}{{.State.Status}}{{end}}' "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)
    case "$s" in
      healthy|running) log "$c: $s"; return 0 ;;
      unhealthy|exited|dead|missing) break ;;
    esac
    sleep 3
  done
  sudo docker logs --tail 40 "$c" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    /' >&2
  die "$c did not become healthy (status: $s)"
}
wait_healthy nxeon-whisper 240
wait_healthy nxeon-claudebox 240
wait_healthy nxeon-app 180

# End-to-end through the published loopback port (what Caddy uses).
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/health >/dev/null \
  && log "app reachable on 127.0.0.1:8080" || die "app not reachable on 127.0.0.1:8080"

# Safety: nothing but 127.0.0.1:8080 may be published (docker bypasses ufw).
bad=$(sudo docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Ports}}' | grep -E '0\.0\.0\.0:|\[::\]:|:::' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || log "WARNING: publicly published ports found: $bad"

"${DC[@]}" ps
log "done"

    # Sandbox roots: traverse-only for sandbox uids (they can never list other projects or homes).
    mkdir -p "$PROJECTS_ROOT/.branches" "$HOMES_ROOT" /run/nx-sandbox
    chown "$RUN_UID:$RUN_GID" "$PROJECTS_ROOT" "$PROJECTS_ROOT/.branches" "$HOMES_ROOT" /run/nx-sandbox
    chmod 0711 "$PROJECTS_ROOT" "$PROJECTS_ROOT/.branches" "$HOMES_ROOT"
    chmod 0700 /run/nx-sandbox
    [ -d "$PROJECTS_ROOT/.trash" ] && chmod 0700 "$PROJECTS_ROOT/.trash"
    # Dirs not (yet) handed to a sandbox (e.g. archived projects, never set up) must not be reachable
    # by any sandbox uid either: strip "other" access on every top-level project/branches dir.
    find "$PROJECTS_ROOT" "$PROJECTS_ROOT/.branches" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -perm /007 -exec chmod o-rwx {} + 2>/dev/null || true
    # The server's own home holds the legacy shared Claude config (all projects' old sessions).
    chmod 0700 "/home/$RUN_USER" "$CLAUDE_DIR" /workspace/.tmp 2>/dev/null || true

## 10. Nexus Chat (v6)
- **Conversations** with `conversations.scope = 'nexus'`, `project_id NULL`, private to `created_by` (others — admins

  `runs.nexus_scope` (JSON `{projects:[{id,slug,branch,worktree}], focus, checkpointed}`). Migration v6 rebuilds
  `conversations`/`runs` (FKs off + `foreign_key_check`), adds `users.nexus_sandbox_id`, `messages.handoffs`,
  `nexus_run_commits(run_id, project_id, branch, sha, files, undo_sha)`.

  Viewer-only projects are excluded entirely (no read-only mechanism: access is via the project group, which is rw).

  block with dir, preview URL and top-level files) + rules (work directly for small tasks, propose handoffs for large

input.message:
Nexus Chat is built, deployed (app + claudebox) and verified on https://workspace.trynxeon.com. The sandbox checks passed. 3 real haiku runs cost $0.072 in total. All tests pass. Nothing is committed (left for you).

One side effect to know about first: my first test run added a commit to the owner's **qa-branches-lab**: `960e94d "nxeon: edits before run"`. The project already had about 257 lines of uncommitted `index.html` changes, and the pre-run checkpoint committed them. The file contents did not change. I tried `git reset --mixed HEAD~1` to undo the commit, but it was blocked by a permission prompt, so it's still there. The owner can run that command if they want the edits uncommitted again. I fixed the cause: projects that aren't #focused are no longer committed before a run (details under Checkpoints).

**Design**
- **Shared chat components.** `Chat`, `AssistantMessage`, `PromptBox` and `ContextMeter` now read their store from a React context (`web/src/features/workspace/chatStore.ts`). The project workspace store is the default. Nexus has its own zustand store (`features/nexus/nexusStore.ts`) with the same field names, and it reuses the same reducer and message conversion. The context also carries three hooks: extra content under a run, the empty state, and prompt add-ons (`#` mentions, scope info, cost notice, hidden agent picker).
- **Scope**, recomputed on every run:
  - Admins get all non-archived projects; members get projects where their effective role is editor or higher.
  - Viewer-only projects are excluded entirely. Access goes through the project's group, which is always read-write, so there is no safe read-only option.
  - Each user gets a Nexus identity uid of 30000+n (`users.nexus_sandbox_id`, never reused). Supplementary groups are the gids of the projects in scope.
  - The run's working dir is a private scratch dir, `/workspace/.nexus/<uid>`. `addDirs` are the main checkouts, plus branch worktrees only when written as `#slug@branch`.
  - No subagents and no preview port. Defaults are Sonnet with thinking "normal" (effort medium).
- **Project index** in the system prompt is capped at 6000 chars (about 1.5k tokens). Each project gets one line: slug, name, description, tech hint (from package.json or index.html, cached by mtime), branches, last activity and a BUSY flag. When the list is too long it shortens step by step, down to slugs only. #focused projects get a detail block with dir, preview URL and top-level files. The prompt also carries the rules: do small tasks directly, hand off large ones, keep the token budget, touch only listed projects, checkpoints are automatic.
- **Handoffs:** Claude can end with `<nx-handoff>[…]</nx-handoff>`. It is hidden from the reply like `<nx-suggestions>`, checked against the scope, and capped at 4. It shows as "Send to <project>" buttons and never runs on its own. Sending creates a conversation in that project and runs it in the background. A progress chip links to `/p/<slug>?conv=<id>` (I added `?conv=` support to the workspace page).
- **Checkpoints:**
  - #focused checkouts get "edits before run".
  - Other checkouts are only checked read-only (`git status`) before the run.
  - After a successful write-mode run, each changed checkout gets "nxeon (nexus): <prompt>", recorded in `nexus_run_commits`.
